host.description: Hostname for shorthand expansion (schema v4+), hostname only - no protocol or slashes. Defaults to github.com.

owner.description: Default owner for shorthand repository entries (schema v4+). A string entry "repo" or "owner/repo" expands to https://<host>/<owner>/<name>.

anyOf.description: Shorthand repository name: either "repo" (expands against the manifest's owner) or "owner/repo" (expands against the manifest's host with an inline owner).

name.description: Local checkout label (a single path segment under repositoriesDirectory): no slashes or path traversal; must be unique across the composed tree.

owner.description: Expand this entry against the manifest's host instead of providing a url: https://<host>/<owner>/<name>. Mutually exclusive with url.

url.description: Clone URL for any Git host. Mutually exclusive with owner.
